method: Built-in image_gen edit, one call per scene with previously inspected original reference; selected outputs copied unchanged. WebP derivatives are encoding only.
scope: Prepared originals for remaining three Starter scenes, not runtime integration or visual acceptance. River raw full-image failure requires bounded-region composition before these can enter gameplay.

assets.promptSummary: Standing hero purple shirt/trousers to green; flying hero red cape to gold; tower red dome to blue. Preserve all other scene details.

deliveryDerivative.method: cwebp -q90 encoding only, no crop/resize/creative edit

assets.rootReview: Three intended changes visible. Full generated raster is NOT accepted as a pair because incidental redraws may occur; integrate only through validated localized regions and independently check seams and unwanted differences.
